checklist.title: Prevent malicious wallet provider injection attacks
checklist.detection_procedure: BOUNDARY: Wallet extension injecting provider via EDGE-INJECTION is UNTRUSTED. The DApp must not blindly trust the injected provider object. Provider could be a malicious wallet extension emitting false connect/disconnect events or returning incorrect chainId. The user trust assumption (ASSUM-EIP2786-01) highlights that users may trust the browser extension mechanism, but DApps must implement additional validation to protect against compromised or malicious extensions.
executable_checks: CRITICAL: Verify that DApp does not automatically trust ethereum.isConnected() without cross-validation against actual RPC state
CRITICAL: Verify chainId from provider.chainId is validated against eth_chainId RPC call response
CRITICAL: Verify connect/disconnect events are treated as unauthenticated signals and not used for authorization decisions
HIGH: Verify DApp implements provider detection logic to identify and warn about multiple conflicting providers
HIGH: Verify DApp handles provider injection timing race conditions gracefully without security exceptions
checklist.notes: Trust model: Wallet extension injection (EDGE-INJECTION) crosses the browser security boundary. Multiple wallet extensions may compete, causing inconsistent event delivery. Provider object content is fully attacker-controlled if malicious extension is installed.

checklist.title: Falsify: Multiple provider injection causes inconsistent event delivery
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Test state transitions by attempting to violate the invariant that DApps can distinguish between multiple wallet providers. Inject multiple providers simultaneously and verify that event delivery remains consistent and DApp can identify all providers without conflicts.
executable_checks: MEDIUM: Install multiple wallet extensions and verify DApp can enumerate all providers via window.ethereum property inspection
MEDIUM: Verify conflicting chainId values from multiple providers do not cause DApp to enter invalid state
MEDIUM: Verify connect events from multiple providers are delivered to correct listeners without cross-contamination
MEDIUM: Test that provider override attacks (last-loaded provider shadows earlier ones) are detected
checklist.notes: ASSUM-EIP2786-02: Multiple wallet extensions may install providers that conflict. The browser extension isolation model may not prevent namespace collisions at window.ethereum.

checklist.title: Prevent acceptance of blocks with missing parent
checklist.detection_procedure: BOUNDARY: Network peer via EDGE-PEER-SENDS-BLOCK is UNTRUSTED. Block received must have parent block present in fork choice store before acceptance. Peer could send blocks with fabricated parent_hash or blocks arriving out of order. Full block validation required per trust model: ancestry verification, temporal validity, finalization constraints, and state transition execution.
executable_checks: CRITICAL: Send beacon block with parent_hash pointing to non-existent block and verify rejection before fork choice store insertion
CRITICAL: Verify blocks are buffered if parent arrives late, not rejected immediately
CRITICAL: Test fork choice store ancestry walk correctly identifies missing parent regardless of block depth
CRITICAL: Verify orphaned blocks are eventually pruned after timeout without consuming unbounded memory
checklist.notes: Trust model EXT-PEER-P2P-BEACON: Unauthenticated P2P network peers can send arbitrary signed beacon blocks. Security assumption requires full ancestry validation before store acceptance.

checklist.title: Falsify: Block violating finalization constraints is accepted
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Test state transitions by attempting to bypass finalization verification. Create block with slot before finalized epoch boundary or block that does not descend from finalized checkpoint and verify rejection.
executable_checks: CRITICAL: Submit block with slot < finalized_epoch * SLOTS_PER_EPOCH and verify rejection with finalization violation error
CRITICAL: Submit block with valid slot but ancestry not descending from finalized checkpoint and verify rejection
CRITICAL: Verify finalized checkpoint itself cannot be reverted by any subsequent block proposal
HIGH: Test that finalization verification occurs before expensive state transition execution
checklist.notes: Finalization provides economic finality. Blocks violating finalization constraints must be rejected to prevent long-range reorganization attacks.

checklist.title: Prevent execution engine from falsely reporting inclusion list satisfaction
checklist.detection_procedure: BOUNDARY: Execution engine response via EDGE-EL-ENGINE-API-RESPONSE is SEMI_TRUSTED. The is_inclusion_list_satisfied() response must be treated defensively. A false response could allow censoring proposers to bypass inclusion list enforcement. CL must validate EL responses and cross-check when possible. Trust model indicates JWT authentication secures channel but response content requires validation.
executable_checks: CRITICAL: Submit block with missing inclusion list transactions and verify CL detects false positive is_inclusion_list_satisfied response
HIGH: Verify CL maintains independent tracking of inclusion list satisfaction and flags mismatches with EL responses
HIGH: Test that blocks marked IL-unsatisfied by EL are correctly added to unsatisfied_inclusion_list_blocks set
MEDIUM: Verify CL logs discrepancies between expected and actual IL satisfaction for monitoring
checklist.notes: Trust model EXT-EXECUTION-ENGINE-VIA-ENGINE-API: JWT-authenticated but responses require validation. ASSUM-EIP7805FC-01: A faulty EL could falsely report IL satisfaction, enabling censorship.

checklist.title: Prevent acceptance of invalid inclusion lists from committee members
checklist.detection_procedure: BOUNDARY: Inclusion list committee member via EDGE-COMMITTEE-SENDS-IL is UNTRUSTED. Must validate committee membership, BLS signature, timing (before VIEW_FREEZE_CUTOFF at 75% of slot), and transaction content validity. Malicious committee members could submit conflicting or late lists per trust model.
executable_checks: HIGH: Submit inclusion list with invalid BLS signature and verify rejection
HIGH: Submit inclusion list after VIEW_FREEZE_CUTOFF and verify rejection as late submission
HIGH: Submit inclusion list from non-committee member validator and verify rejection
HIGH: Submit inclusion list with invalid transaction encoding and verify transaction validation fails
MEDIUM: Verify inclusion lists are validated for correct slot assignment
checklist.notes: Trust model EXT-IL-COMMITTEE-MEMBER-P2P: Committee members broadcast signed lists over unauthenticated P2P. Full validation required before accepting.

checklist.title: Falsify: IL satisfaction result is re-evaluated after caching
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Test state transitions by attempting to trigger re-evaluation of IL satisfaction result. Once a block passes IL check, result must be cached permanently and never re-evaluated, even if inclusion lists are later pruned (AMB-EIP7805FC-01).
executable_checks: HIGH: Mark block as IL-satisfied, then prune inclusion lists and verify block remains marked satisfied
HIGH: Verify fork choice queries for IL satisfaction return cached result without re-computation
HIGH: Test that IL-satisfied status persists across node restarts when loaded from database
MEDIUM: Verify IL satisfaction cache cannot be invalidated or cleared during normal operation
checklist.notes: AMB-EIP7805FC-01: Satisfaction result must be permanent to prevent re-evaluation attacks after inclusion list pruning.

checklist.title: Prevent invalid subscription parameter combinations
checklist.detection_procedure: BOUNDARY: User via EDGE-USER-SUBSCRIBES-RPC is UNTRUSTED. Must provide exactly one of 'transaction' or 'hash' parameters. Trust model indicates unauthenticated public RPC endpoint requires full parameter validation with mutual exclusion check.
executable_checks: LOW: Submit eth_subscribe with both transaction and hash parameters and verify JSON-RPC error -32602
LOW: Submit eth_subscribe with neither transaction nor hash and verify error -32602
LOW: Submit eth_subscribe with transaction parameter only and verify subscription succeeds
LOW: Submit eth_subscribe with hash parameter only and verify subscription succeeds
checklist.notes: Trust model EXT-USER-VIA-JSON-RPC: Unauthenticated RPC endpoint. Full parameter validation required including mutual exclusion.

checklist.title: Verify: Transaction inclusion notification contains complete receipt and block details
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: After transaction is found in canonical chain block, verify notification with status 'included' is sent containing receipt and block details as required by post-condition.
executable_checks: LOW: Monitor subscription and verify included notification contains valid receipt object (status, gasUsed, logs)
LOW: Verify included notification contains block hash, block number, and transaction index
LOW: Verify notification is sent only after block is in canonical chain, not in uncle/orphan block
LOW: Test that notification timestamp is reasonable (within propagation delay of block arrival)
checklist.notes: Post-condition verification: Ensures transparency of transaction lifecycle for monitoring applications.

checklist.title: Falsify: Monitoring mechanism prevents reorg-based attacks
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Test state transitions by verifying that monitoring provides transparency but not protection. Applications must not assume monitoring prevents reorg attacks (ASSUM-EIP8072-04).
executable_checks: MEDIUM: Submit transaction, receive included notification, then force chain reorganization and verify reorged notification is sent
MEDIUM: Verify that applications relying solely on included status (without waiting for finality) can be exploited by reorg
MEDIUM: Test that finalized notification is only sent after consensus-layer finality is achieved
MEDIUM: Verify monitoring does not rate-limit or prevent block producers from executing reorganizations
checklist.notes: ASSUM-EIP8072-04: Monitoring provides visibility, not protection. Applications must wait for finality for security-critical operations.

checklist.title: Acknowledge: Node operators can observe transaction monitoring patterns
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Verify that subscription patterns expose which transactions users are monitoring. This privacy exposure cannot be mitigated at protocol level (ASSUM-EIP8072-02). Document and ensure applications are aware of this limitation.
executable_checks: LOW: Verify node operator can log which transaction hashes are subscribed to by which connections
LOW: Document that users monitoring high-value transactions expose interest to node operators
LOW: Verify no protocol-level mechanism exists to blind subscription targets from node operator
LOW: Recommend use of trusted node or Tor for privacy-sensitive monitoring
checklist.notes: ASSUM-EIP8072-02: Node operators have visibility into monitoring patterns. This is accepted protocol limitation, not a bug.

checklist.title: Validate RANDAO value confirms PoS execution context
checklist.detection_procedure: BOUNDARY: Consensus layer via Engine API (EDGE-CL-ENGINE-API-CALL) provides RANDAO in mixHash field. Trust model indicates JWT authentication but content validation required. RANDAO value must be validated: values exceeding 2^64 confirm PoS execution context per AMB-EIP4399-01.
executable_checks: MEDIUM: Submit execution payload with mixHash value <= 2^64 and verify rejection as invalid PoS context
MEDIUM: Verify PREVRANDAO opcode execution in post-merge block returns mixHash value from header
MEDIUM: Test that pre-merge blocks correctly return difficulty value, not RANDAO
LOW: Verify merge transition boundary correctly switches from difficulty to RANDAO interpretation
checklist.notes: Trust model EXT-CL-VIA-ENGINE-API: JWT-authenticated but RANDAO value range must be validated. AMB-EIP4399-01 clarifies >2^64 confirms PoS.

checklist.title: Verify: PREVRANDAO returns difficulty in pre-merge blocks
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: After opcode 0x44 executes in pre-merge block, EVM stack must contain traditional PoW difficulty value. This preserves backward compatibility for contracts deployed before the merge.
executable_checks: MEDIUM: Execute PREVRANDAO opcode in pre-merge block simulation and verify stack contains difficulty value
MEDIUM: Verify contracts using DIFFICULTY opcode continue to work identically pre-merge
MEDIUM: Test that difficulty value matches block header difficulty field exactly
LOW: Verify pre-merge difficulty values never exceed reasonable PoW range
checklist.notes: Backward compatibility requirement: Pre-merge contracts using DIFFICULTY must continue functioning.

checklist.title: Falsify: Fork activates with missing dependencies
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Test state transitions by attempting to activate Cancun fork without required cryptographic libraries and module dependencies. Missing dependencies during activation would cause consensus split (ASSUM-CANCUN-INDEX-01).
executable_checks: CRITICAL: Remove KZG cryptography module and verify node fails to start with clear dependency error
CRITICAL: Test fork activation detects missing modules before accepting Cancun blocks
CRITICAL: Verify node startup checks include comprehensive dependency verification
HIGH: Test that missing optional modules generate warnings but missing required modules cause hard failures
checklist.notes: ASSUM-CANCUN-INDEX-01: Missing dependencies at fork activation cause consensus split. Pre-activation verification critical.

checklist.title: Falsify: Network upgrades without sufficient participant notice
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Test state transitions by verifying sufficient notice period for network participants to upgrade. Nodes running old software will be forked off (ASSUM-EIP8081-03). Insufficient notice increases risk of chain split.
executable_checks: HIGH: Verify upgrade announcement includes activation epoch/timestamp with minimum 2-week notice
HIGH: Test that nodes without upgrade software are forked off at activation boundary
HIGH: Verify network monitoring can detect percentage of nodes running old software
MEDIUM: Test that activation can be delayed if insufficient nodes have upgraded
MEDIUM: Document recommended upgrade timeline for node operators
checklist.notes: ASSUM-EIP8081-03: Network participants need sufficient notice. AMB-EIP8081-01: Activation timing must balance urgency and adoption.

checklist.title: Falsify: Builder deposits misclassified as validator deposits
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Builder deposits must be reliably distinguished from validator deposits via withdrawal credentials alone. Misclassification could disrupt both consensus and block building (ASSUM-GLOAS-FORK-01).
executable_checks: HIGH: Submit deposit with builder withdrawal credentials and verify correct classification as builder
HIGH: Submit deposit with validator withdrawal credentials and verify classification as validator
HIGH: Test edge case withdrawal credentials that could be ambiguous and verify deterministic classification
MEDIUM: Verify classification logic is consistent across all client implementations
checklist.notes: ASSUM-GLOAS-FORK-01: Withdrawal credentials are the sole distinguishing factor. Classification must be deterministic and correct.

checklist.title: Prevent unauthorized access to metrics endpoint
checklist.detection_procedure: BOUNDARY: Prometheus server via EDGE-SCRAPE is UNTRUSTED. Metrics endpoint must be network-restricted to authorized monitoring systems. Exposed metrics provide operational intelligence that could aid attack timing (ASSUM-EIP2159-01). No authentication defined in EIP-2159 per trust model.
executable_checks: MEDIUM: Attempt to access metrics endpoint from unauthorized IP and verify connection refused or 403 error
MEDIUM: Verify metrics endpoint is bound to localhost or management network, not public interface
MEDIUM: Test that metrics do not expose sensitive data like validator keys or private network topology
LOW: Verify metrics endpoint does not leak software version information that aids targeted exploits
checklist.notes: Trust model EXT-PROMETHEUS-SCRAPER: UNTRUSTED by default. ASSUM-EIP2159-01/03: Should be network-restricted to prevent attack timing intelligence.

checklist.title: Acknowledge: Metrics endpoint exposes operational state to attackers
checklist.detection_procedure: BOUNDARY: Trust model indicates metrics endpoint should treat Prometheus scrapers as UNTRUSTED. Malicious actors accessing endpoint could use sync state and peer count data to time attacks (ASSUM-EIP2159-03). Document risk and mitigation.
executable_checks: LOW: Verify sync state metrics (ethereum_blockchain_height, ethereum_best_known_block_number) are exposed
LOW: Verify peer count metric exposes current connection state
LOW: Document that attackers with metrics access can identify optimal attack timing (during sync)
LOW: Recommend network-level access control and metrics scraping over VPN/private network
checklist.notes: ASSUM-EIP2159-03: Metrics provide attack timing intelligence. This is accepted risk requiring operational mitigation, not protocol fix.

checklist.title: Validate blob KZG commitments and proofs at CL-EL boundary
checklist.detection_procedure: BOUNDARY: Consensus layer via EDGE-BLOBS-TO-ENGINE (Engine API) sends blobs to EL. Trust model indicates SEMI_TRUSTED with JWT authentication but content validation required (ASSUM-EIP7928-02). Each blob must have valid KZG commitment and proof verified before crossing boundary.
executable_checks: CRITICAL: Submit blob with invalid KZG proof and verify rejection before EL processing
CRITICAL: Submit blob with commitment not matching blob data and verify rejection
CRITICAL: Verify KZG verification occurs before blob is stored or gossiped
HIGH: Test that KZG verification failure triggers appropriate error response to CL
checklist.notes: Trust model EXT-CL-VIA-ENGINE-API: JWT-authenticated but blob content must be validated. ASSUM-EIP7928-02: Invalid KZG proofs must be rejected.

checklist.title: Falsify: Client implementations produce divergent state transitions
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: All client implementations must produce identical state transitions for same inputs. Python reference implementation is canonical per ASSUM-CONSENSUSSPECS-01. Test by running multiple clients against same inputs and comparing outputs.
executable_checks: CRITICAL: Run consensus test vectors across all major clients and verify identical state roots
CRITICAL: Test edge cases (boundary epochs, fork transitions) across clients for consistency
HIGH: Verify clients produce identical attestation and block validation decisions
HIGH: Test that slashing detection produces identical results across implementations
checklist.notes: ASSUM-CONSENSUSSPECS-01: Python reference is canonical. Client divergence causes chain split. Comprehensive cross-client testing required.

checklist.title: Prevent malicious DApp fake ABI attacks
checklist.detection_procedure: BOUNDARY: Malicious DApp via EDGE-MALICIOUS-DAPP-ABI is UNTRUSTED. When DApp provides fake ABI, wallet must not present decoded calldata as authoritative. Trust model indicates this is explicit attack vector requiring visual distinction between verified and unverified ABI sources (ASSUM-EIP7896-01).
executable_checks: HIGH: Provide fake ABI with misleading function names and verify wallet shows unverified warning
HIGH: Verify decoded calldata display includes visual indicator of ABI source trust level
HIGH: Test that wallet queries trusted ABI database when available and marks results as verified
MEDIUM: Verify users cannot proceed without acknowledging unverified ABI warning
checklist.notes: Trust model EXT-MALICIOUS-DAPP: Attacker-controlled app providing misleading ABIs. ASSUM-EIP7896-01: Wallets must visually distinguish trust levels.

checklist.title: Falsify: TSTORE executes within STATICCALL context
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Test state transitions by attempting TSTORE within STATICCALL context. This must throw static context violation exception. STATICCALL is read-only frame.
executable_checks: HIGH: Execute TSTORE opcode within STATICCALL frame and verify exception is thrown
HIGH: Verify exception halts execution and reverts transient storage changes
HIGH: Test that TLOAD (read-only) succeeds within STATICCALL context
MEDIUM: Verify nested STATICCALL frames also prevent TSTORE execution
checklist.notes: TSTORE modifies state and must not execute in read-only STATICCALL context. Exception must be thrown immediately.

checklist.title: Falsify: Transient storage ownership incorrect for call types
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Test state transitions by verifying transient storage ownership. Regular CALL/STATICCALL: owned by callee. DELEGATECALL/CALLCODE: owned by caller (msg.sender context) per ASSUM-EIP1153-02.
executable_checks: MEDIUM: Execute TSTORE in regular CALL and verify storage is isolated to callee address
MEDIUM: Execute TSTORE in DELEGATECALL and verify storage is associated with caller address
MEDIUM: Test that CALLCODE shares caller's transient storage consistent with DELEGATECALL
LOW: Verify cross-contract TLOAD cannot access other contract's transient storage in regular CALL
checklist.notes: ASSUM-EIP1153-02: Ownership semantics mirror persistent storage. Critical for security model of libraries and proxies.

checklist.title: Prevent unauthorized Engine API access
checklist.detection_procedure: BOUNDARY: Any entity connecting to Engine API port via EDGE-ENGINE-API-PORT-AUTH is UNTRUSTED before authentication. Trust model indicates JWT bearer token required. Invalid/expired/missing JWT must be rejected immediately (ASSUM-ENGINE-API-01).
executable_checks: CRITICAL: Send Engine API request without JWT and verify immediate rejection
CRITICAL: Send request with invalid JWT signature and verify rejection
CRITICAL: Send request with expired JWT timestamp and verify rejection
HIGH: Verify JWT secret cannot be brute-forced due to sufficient entropy (>=256 bits)
HIGH: Test that failed authentication attempts are rate-limited to prevent DoS
checklist.notes: Trust model EXT-ENGINE-API-CALLER: UNTRUSTED before auth. ASSUM-ENGINE-API-01: JWT authentication gates all access. Shared secret must be secure.

checklist.title: Prevent Engine API race conditions via sequential processing
checklist.detection_procedure: BOUNDARY: Consensus layer via Engine API (EDGE-CL-FORKCHOICE-TO-EL) calls must be processed sequentially. Concurrent forkchoice updates must not be allowed to prevent race conditions (ASSUM-ENGINE-API-03).
executable_checks: HIGH: Send multiple concurrent engine_forkchoiceUpdated calls and verify sequential processing (second waits for first)
HIGH: Verify forkchoice state updates are atomic and consistent
HIGH: Test that out-of-order messages are queued and processed in arrival order
MEDIUM: Verify no race condition between forkchoiceUpdated and newPayload calls
checklist.notes: ASSUM-ENGINE-API-03: Sequential processing prevents race conditions. Concurrent updates could corrupt canonical chain state.

checklist.title: Prevent data column sidecar subnet routing violations
checklist.detection_procedure: BOUNDARY: P2P gossip peer via EDGE-GOSSIP-DATA-COLUMN-VALIDATION is UNTRUSTED. Data column sidecar must be received on correct subnet: column_index % DATA_COLUMN_SIDECAR_SUBNET_COUNT must equal subnet_id. Incorrect routing must cause REJECT.
executable_checks: MEDIUM: Gossip data column on wrong subnet (column_index % 128 != subnet_id) and verify REJECT with routing error
MEDIUM: Verify correctly routed data columns are accepted on their designated subnet
MEDIUM: Test that nodes subscribe to correct subnets based on custody group assignment
LOW: Verify subnet routing check occurs before expensive cryptographic validation
checklist.notes: Trust model EXT-GOSSIP-PEER: UNTRUSTED. Peers can broadcast to wrong subnets. Early routing validation prevents resource exhaustion.

checklist.title: Prevent DataColumnSidecarsByRoot requests outside serve range
checklist.detection_procedure: BOUNDARY: Requesting peer via EDGE-REQRESP-DATA-COLUMN is UNTRUSTED. DataColumnSidecarsByRoot requests must reference block_roots since minimum_request_epoch. Requests for data outside serve range must return ResourceUnavailable (error code 3).
executable_checks: LOW: Request data columns for block_root older than minimum_request_epoch and verify ResourceUnavailable (3) response
LOW: Request data columns for future block_root and verify appropriate error response
LOW: Verify nodes correctly calculate and enforce minimum_request_epoch boundary
LOW: Test that serve range enforcement prevents unbounded historical data requests
checklist.notes: Trust model EXT-REQUESTING-PEER: UNTRUSTED. Serve range limits prevent resource exhaustion from historical data requests.
